start: HQ open on Needs you, browser notifications not asked yet

steps.action: In the card 'Alerts', tap 'Turn on alerts' and allow in the browser
must_not: The browser asking on page load without a tap

steps.action: Leave HQ open in a tab; a new lead arrives
user_sees: Within a minute a short sound and the pop-up 'MettleUp HQ: needs you' with the new line
The number on the menu and in the tab title goes up
must_not: A pop-up for something that is not new
Two pop-ups for one new thing

user_sees: The HQ tab comes to the front on the matching page

start: HQ open on another page, alerts on, a new help question arrives

user_sees: A short sound and the pop-up
must_not: The page being typed in reloaded

start: Notifications blocked, or the user tapped Block when asked

steps.action: Tap 'Turn on alerts' and pick Block
user_sees: 'Alerts stay off. You can still see the number on the menu.'
'Alerts are blocked in this browser. Allow notifications for this site in the browser’s settings to get them.'
must_not: The Turn on alerts button shown again

steps.action: A new lead arrives while HQ is open
user_sees: The number on the menu goes up, no sound
must_not: A sound plays even though alerts are off

start: Alerts on, one new lead waiting

steps.action: Open the lead and mark it called
user_sees: The number goes down at the next check
must_not: A sound when a number goes down
No sound because the number had gone down and up again

user_sees: No alert on the first check after a reload
must_not: A pop-up for everything already waiting on every reload

start: Alerts on, laptop screen shared or locked

user_sees: The pop-up 'MettleUp HQ: needs you' with the line words
must_not: A member name, phone number or message text in the pop-up
